meta.name: experiment-readout
meta.description: 假设 + 指标 + 结果 + 解释 + 决策, 把 A/B 或产品实验转成行动建议

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把实验数据转化为可执行的行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常分析产品实验并需要清晰的下一步行动
copy.tagline_en: Turn experiment data into actionable recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze product experiments and need clear next steps

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把实验数据整理成一份结构化复盘报告:包含假设、样本设置、指标对比、结果解读和上线/停止/继续/重设计等决策建议,并列出后续实验。
howto.when: 当用户提供实验数据(如 A/B 测试、功能灰度等),并希望得到复盘结论或上线/停止决策时触发。

say.text: 帮我复盘这个 A/B 测试:注册率 12% vs 10%,样本 5000。
say.note: 会生成一份含假设、指标和决策的实验复盘。

say.text: 把这份 CSV 实验结果转成决策报告,标明显著性。
say.note: Claude 会解析数据并输出结构化复盘。

say.text: 这个定价实验该上线、继续还是停止?给出理由。
say.note: 会基于数据给出四选一决策和后续实验。

howto.what_en: Claude turns experiment data into a structured readout: hypothesis, setup, metric table, interpretation, and a ship/iterate/extend/stop decision, plus follow-up experiments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides experiment data (e.g., A/B test, feature rollout) and asks for a readout or next-step decision.

say_en.text: Review this A/B test: signup rate 12% vs 10%, n=5000.
say_en.note: Generates a readout with hypothesis, metrics, and decision.

say_en.text: Turn this CSV of experiment results into a decision report, noting significance.
say_en.note: Parses data and outputs a structured readout.

say_en.text: Should this pricing experiment ship, continue, or stop? Give reasons.
say_en.note: Returns a four-way decision with rationale and next experiments.
